paradigm_comparison_disclaimer: DNN V2 is trained with supervised Attack labels (test1+test2) and calibrated on labeled Validation (test3), whereas GRU/Ridge/Persistence V1 are trained unsupervised on Normal data only (train1+train2) with Q99.9 thresholds calibrated on Normal data (train3). This comparison evaluates two distinct learning paradigms and supervision regimes on the common test4+test5 split (17 attacks, t >= 30), and does not isolate architecture alone.
blindness_disclaimer: test4 and test5 are strictly held out from DNN V2 training, validation, and threshold selection, but were previously analyzed in V1 final evaluation and are NOT a completely blind test of the overall project.
